title: Top Coding Interview Questions
description: The classic questions interviewers love: arrays, strings, DP, graphs and more. Work through them in order, easy to hard.

title: Arrays & Hashing
description: Array manipulation and hash map / hash set tricks, the foundation of most interview rounds.

title: Strings
description: Palindromes, anagrams, sliding windows and character counting.

title: Two Pointers & Sliding Window
description: Linear-time techniques that replace nested loops.

title: Linked Lists
description: Pointer manipulation: reversal, cycles, merging and removal.

title: Stacks & Queues
description: LIFO and FIFO structures, monotonic stacks and matching problems.

title: Trees & Graphs
description: Tree traversals, depth, balance, BFS/DFS on trees and grids.

title: Recursion & Dynamic Programming
description: From recursion basics to classic DP problems such as coin change and house robber.

title: Sorting & Searching
description: Sorting algorithms, binary search and divide and conquer.

title: SQL Interview Questions
description: Every SQL interview staple: joins, self joins, group by, subqueries, window functions. SQLite dialect with ORDER BY required.

title: SQL Joins & Self Joins
description: Inner, left and self joins, the most asked SQL interview topic.

title: SQL Aggregation & Window Functions
description: GROUP BY / HAVING, ranking, running totals and LAG.
